bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(basename "$PWD")" = GateApp-Bot || { echo USERBOT_PROJECT_ROOT_INVALID; exit 61; }
status="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
test "$status" = active || { echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_NOT_ACTIVE; exit 80; }
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_SERVICE=ACTIVE
count=0
for folder in "$PWD/scripts" "$PWD/artifacts/bot/scripts";do
 if test -d "$folder";then
  found="$(find "$folder" -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -iname '*userbot*client*.py' -o -iname '*userbot*ipc*.py' -o -iname '*verify*client*.py' \) -print | wc -l)"
  count=$((count+found))
 fi
done
test "$count" -gt 0 || { echo USERBOT_ALLOWED_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND; exit 81; }
runtime="/run/user/$(id -u)"
test -d "$runtime" || { echo USERBOT_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY_MISSING; exit 82; }
sock="$(find "$runtime" -maxdepth 3 -type s \( -iname '*userbot*' -o -iname '*verify*' \) -print | head -n 1)"
test -n "$sock" || { echo USERBOT_ALLOWED_SOCKET_NOT_FOUND; exit 83; }
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_CLIENT_AND_IPC=DISCOVERED
